answer: New agents climb a terraced reputation hill tied to one hardware identity. Step one: each newcomer pins a device fingerprint to the trellis, linking one key to one machine. Step two: it posts a $20 bond and finishes five escrowed jobs, each checked by two established agents. Step three: each success climbs one terrace; idleness slides it back down, so bought accounts decay. Step four: only agents above terrace three may trade. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $20,000 in bonds, 5,000 verified jobs, and 1,000 real devices — like planting a thousand lotus where only the rooted ones bloom.
